business_summary: Jiangsu Flag Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of green pesticide products in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company offers herbicide products, including fluroxypyr-meptyl, cyhalofop-butyl, clodinafop-propargyl, carfentrazone-ethyl, bispyribac-sodium, haloxyfop-P-methyl, imazamox, isoxaflutole, fenoxaprop-P-ethyl, imazapic, imazethapyr, and cloquintocet-mexyl tech products; insecticides, including clothianidin, lufenuron, novaluron, and spirotetramat tech products; fungicides, such as fluazinam, cyproconazole, and pyraclostrobin tech products; and formulations. It also engages in equity investment, technical services, and technology development activities. Jiangsu Flag Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Nanjing, China.
business_summary_ko: Jiangsu Flag Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 녹색 농약 제품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 fluroxypyr-meptyl, cyhalofop-부틸, clodinafop-propargyl, carfentrazone-ethyl, bispyribac-sodium, haloxyfop-P-methyl, imazamox, isoxaflutole, fenoxaprop-P-ethyl, imazapic, imazethapyr 및 cloquintocet-mexyl 기술 제품을 포함한 제초제 제품을 제공합니다. 클로티아니딘, 루페누론, 노발루론 및 스피로테트라마트 테크 제품을 포함한 살충제; 플루아지남(fluazinam), 시프로코나졸(cyproconazole) 및 피라클로스트로빈 기술 제품과 같은 살균제; 그리고 공식. 또한 지분 투자, 기술 서비스, 기술 개발 활동에도 참여합니다. Jiangsu Flag Chemical Industry Co., Ltd.는 2003년에 설립되었으며 중국 난징에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
